title: Cover Story
summary: River gives you an alias at a Santo Domingo night market and bets you cannot get a free coffee with it.
description: River has given V an alias for the night market in Santo Domingo. He bets V cannot get a free coffee with it from the vendor behind the stall.

start.bringUp: River wants to test V's cover story at the Santo Domingo night market. He gives V an alias and bets V cannot get a free coffee with it.

variations.know: V invents the alias this time, and River waits to see whether it holds at the vendor's stall.
variations.wants: An alias V can keep straight.

variations.know: River tries the alias on the vendor himself, and the vendor is not impressed.
A stranger in the next stall is running a cover story too, and the two of you are trying to outdo each other.
variations.wants: A better story than the stranger's.

market.name: the night market in Santo Domingo

RWH5.inv.text: Santo Domingo night market. I'll give you an alias. Get a free coffee with it. If you can.

g1.asks: Which part of the story did you almost believe yourself?
g1.know: You have tried the alias on the vendor, and you know how the vendor reacted.
g1.secret: He learned to lie from the job and misses nothing about it.

stages.label: V tries the alias on a night market vendor
stages.objective: Try River's alias on the night market vendor
stages.know: You are at the night market in Santo Domingo with River. He has given you an alias, and a vendor is behind the coffee stall.
stages.wants: V to get a free coffee with the story.

coffee.memory: You got a free coffee at the Santo Domingo night market with River's alias, even though the vendor saw through it.

caught.memory: The vendor at the Santo Domingo night market saw through your alias within a minute, but the story kept River laughing.

stood-up.memory: You never came to the Santo Domingo night market, and River told his alias to the vendor alone.
